findings.message: Exfiltration path: reads sensitive data (customers-db, filesystem, github, terminal), ingests untrusted content (fetch, github) and can send data out (fetch, github) with no human approval. A prompt injection in the untrusted content could leak the data.
findings.recommendation: Break the chain: split the agent, remove one leg, or require approval on every egress action.
